analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free vulnerability occurs when the Variant_clear function is called on a UA_Variant structure that holds a pointer to already freed memory. Specifically, the issue arises in the Variant_clear function when it tries to delete the data in a UA_Variant without checking if the data has already been freed, leading to an attempt to access and clear freed memory.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: This vulnerability is triggered when the UA_decodeJson function processes a JSON input that leads to the UA_Variant structure being cleared without proper memory management. If the JSON parsing does not correctly allocate or manage memory for the variants, it can result in freeing memory that is still referenced, causing subsequent calls to access invalid memory.
